description: Primary Card Number is required when Liability Indicator is 003
Amount of installment required for all facilities except 002, 003, 004
Highest credit amount should be null for any other facility than 002, 003, 004
Highest credit amount should not be null for facilities 002, 003, 004
For facilities other than revolving facilities (002, 003, 004) the term of loan is required
If Number of days past due is greater than 0 then Amount Overdue cannot be zero
If Amount Overdue is greater than zero, Last Payment Date cannot be null
If Account status is 005 'Written Off' then Credit Facility Write-Off Date cannot be null
If Account status is 005 'Written Off' then Amount Written Off should be greater than zero
If Account status is 003 'Closed' then Account Closed Date should be not null
If Account status is not 005 'Written Off' then Amount Written Off should be zero or null
If Credit facility is other than 002,003,004 then Number of Installment should be greater than zero
If Funding Source is 002 (External Source), then Funding Reference Code is required
If Currency is not EGP, then Currency in EGP must be reported
If Currency is not EGP, then Credit Limit/Approval Amount in EGP must be reported
If Currency is not EGP, then Balance in EGP must be reported
If Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002, then Securitization Amount must be reported
If Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002, then Issuance Date must be reported
If Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002, then Securitization Tenor must be reported
If Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002, then Issuance No must be reported
If Securitization Indicator is 001 or 002, then Issuer must be reported
If Liability Indicator is 004, 010, 011, 012, 013, 014, or 016, then Borrower Identification Code must be reported
If Borrower Identification Code is reported, then Borrower Identification Issuing Authority is required
If Collateral Type 3 is reported it should be 402
condition: Collateral_Type_3 is not None and Collateral_Type_3 != '402'

description: Make sure Segment_Identifier is CNCF
